description: Security incident: CloudTrail detects an IAM anomaly — a user key created 3 hours ago is making DescribeInstances calls from an unexpected geolocation. Isolate the EC2 instance the key has access to via a security group ingress revoke, rotate all IAM keys associated with the compromised user, take a forensic EBS snapshot of every attached volume, and verify no further anomalous API calls appear in the next 5 minutes of CloudTrail.
